correctness.rationale: For finite Blaschke B, D=I-T_B*T_B=P_h(1-|B|²)|H+H_B*H_B is positive; the monomial projection formula gives squared Hankel tail q²/((j+1)(j+q+1)) for j>=q and bounded first q-1 terms, implying H_{z^q} is Hilbert-Schmidt with norm²<=2q. Exponentially decaying Taylor coefficients of finite B make H_B Hilbert-Schmidt and correction trace class. Radial domination 1-|B|²<=C(1-|z|²) yields s_N(A)=O(1/N). The angular mean of the boundary derivative |B'| is deg B=m, giving for both ±j harmonic modes diagonal m/(j+1)+O(j^-2). Ky Fan lower bound and positive upper compression with M=ceil(N log N) squeeze S_N(A)/log N to 2m. Positive trace-class correction preserves coefficient and non-trace-class result. Independently computed for B=z^m: analytic defect eigenvalues m/(j+m+1), antianalytic tail m/(j+1), validating two contributions (not proving arbitrary finite B). Finite checks are not used for infinite proof.
